resources.name: All-electron or pseudopotential DFT code (FHI-aims or Quantum ESPRESSO)
resources.notes: Open-source; FHI-aims requires registration but is publicly available; Quantum ESPRESSO is freely downloadable.

resources.name: Crystal structures of type-I Si and Ge clathrates (empty and filled)

access.notes: Structures are publicly known; available in COD/ICSD/Materials Project. Lattice parameters and Wyckoff positions are documented in the primary literature.

resources.notes: The agent must construct unit cells for Si46, Na8Si46, K8Si46, Ge46, and K8Ge44□2 from crystallographic data.
